node.title: Node.js versions below 20 are outside the current frontend baseline
node.summary: Move to an active or maintenance LTS line before attempting framework upgrades.
notes: Production applications should use Active LTS or Maintenance LTS release lines.
Validate local build scripts, CI images, and native addons when moving Node majors.

react.title: React 19 requires the modern JSX transform
react.summary: Projects upgrading to React 19 should validate JSX transform settings and related tooling.
notes: If using TypeScript, upgrade @types/react and @types/react-dom with the React major.
Run codemods for React 19 migration where possible.
affectedPatterns: Libraries that depend on React internals

react-dom.title: React DOM upgrade should be reviewed alongside app bootstrap APIs
react-dom.summary: Check client bootstrap points and hydration entry files when moving to React 19.
notes: Search for legacy render and hydrate entrypoints before upgrading.
Confirm SSR and hydration code paths behave correctly after the upgrade.

next.title: Next.js 15 introduces async request APIs
next.summary: Previously synchronous request-bound APIs become asynchronous and may require code changes.
notes: Review uses of cookies, headers, and draftMode in server code.
Review page, layout, route, and metadata functions that access params or searchParams.
React 19 becomes the minimum supported React version.

vite.title: Vite 7 drops Node.js 18 support
vite.summary: Upgrade Node.js before or alongside Vite when targeting Vite 7.
notes: Review browser target defaults if your support matrix includes older browsers.
